title: Director, Quality Operations
text:
**Revvity**

Revvity is a developer and provider of end-to-end solutions designed to help scientists, researchers, and clinicians solve the world’s greatest health challenges. We pair the enthusiasm of an industry disruptor with the experience of a longtime leader. Our team of 11,000+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health.

Find your future at Revvity.

Our team is seeking a Director, Quality Operations to lead site quality for the Hopkinton-based operation. This role succeeds the current site quality leadership position and is intentionally scoped at the Director level because it combines broad operational accountability, organizational build-out, and a significant quality-system integration mandate. The Director will lead a blended Quality Operations organization spanning product quality, quality systems, supplier and incoming quality, inspection, and production support. The successful leader must protect ongoing product quality and compliance while progressively simplifying, integrating, and modernizing the operating model.

 
 

**Routine Responsibilities:**
-----------------------------

**Site Quality Leadership and Governance**
------------------------------------------

* Quality Operations leader for Hopkinton, with accountability for product quality, manufacturing quality, inspection, release, and site QMS execution.

* Provide visible, hands-on leadership in production and laboratory environments, enabling rapid risk-based decisions and timely escalation of material, process, product, and compliance issues.

* Own the site quality operating rhythm, including management review, quality metrics, risk review, resource prioritization, and cross-functional governance with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, R&D, Regulatory, Service, and Commercial teams.

* Serve as the principal site Quality representative for FDA, ISO, notified-body, customer, and internal audits, and ensure sustained inspection readiness across the blended operation.

* Balance product continuity, customer commitments, compliance, and transformation priorities using documented risk-based decisions.

 
 

**QMS, SOP, and Digital-System Integration**
--------------------------------------------

* Create and execute a phased roadmap improve and sustain SOPs and QMS structures supporting the site, with clear process ownership, sequencing, change controls, validation needs, and business-continuity safeguards.

* Optimize operating model for document control, production records, training, calibration, internal audits, supplier management, incoming inspection, final acceptance, complaints, and customer field interfaces.

* Lead the integration and modernization of quality tools and records currently distributed across systems and methods.

* Partner with enterprise Quality, Regulatory, IT/Digital, and business process owners to deploy scalable solutions and eliminate duplicate or conflicting workflows, records, and controls.

* Ensure data integrity, validated-state control, traceability, retention, access, and training are maintained throughout system and process transitions.

 
 

**Product and Manufacturing Quality**
-------------------------------------

* Lead quality support for a diverse portfolio that includes instruments, consumables and reagents platforms.

* Oversee incoming inspection, in-process controls, final product acceptance and release, nonconformance and material-review processes, manufacturing investigations, and CAPA effectiveness.

* Ensure appropriate validation and verification of manufacturing processes, equipment, software-enabled tools, inspection methods, and test methods.

* Drive preventive product-quality improvements using defect, yield, scrap, complaint, service, supplier, and Cost of Poor Quality trends.

* Represent Quality in design transfer, manufacturing transfer, new-product introduction, supplier changes, capacity expansion, and sustaining-engineering decisions.

 
 

**Organization Build and People Leadership**
--------------------------------------------

* Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary team of Quality Systems, Product Quality, Supplier/Incoming Quality, Quality Control, inspection, technician, and specialist roles.

* Implement planned organization expansion, including Quality Systems leadership, compliance coordination, QC supervision, and temporary integration support, while clarifying accountability across product and system responsibilities.

* Build succession depth and technical capability through coaching, performance management, role clarity, development plans, and targeted cross-training across legacy product and QMS environments.

* Set clear performance expectations and foster a culture of ownership, constructive challenge, timely decision-making, and practical continuous improvement.

* Plan resource needs and manage the site Quality Operations budget, contractor usage, and external support in line with the operating plan.

 
 

**Customer, Supplier, and Compliance Interface**
------------------------------------------------

* Own the Quality Operations response to significant customer issues, quality agreements, customer audits, field escalations, and product-quality communications in partnership with Commercial Quality and Regulatory.

* Provide governance for supplier quality and incoming-quality activities, including risk-based controls, supplier corrective action, change assessment, and escalation of supply continuity risks.

* Ensure complaints, quality events, CAPAs, deviations, nonconformances, and risk-management activities are documented, investigated, assessed, and closed with appropriate rigor and timeliness.

* Responsible for customer complaint handling and investigations in collaboration with cross functional teams driving problem solving and resolution plans.

Maintain effective QMS training, document control, internal audit, calibration, and records-management programs across the site scope.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree
* 15+ years of quality experience with 7+ years management experience
 

 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting instruments, reagents and consumable product lines and systems.
* Experience deploying or consolidating eQMS, ERP, PLM, inspection, training, document-control, or calibration systems.
* Lean, Six Sigma, ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, ASQ Certified Quality Engineer, or comparable credentials.
* Experience hosting regulatory and customer audits and managing complex customer-quality interfaces.
* Experience with data analysis, analytics, and management reporting schemes.
 

 

**Physical Requirements & Expectations:**

* The primary working condition associated with this position is working independently in the office environment.
* It is frequently required to work cross-functionally. Travel may be required up to 10%.
* Requires the ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds, sit and/or stand for prolonged periods of time and effectively manage conflict and emotional or stressful situations.
* Potential hazards associated with blood products.

This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the role.

 
 

**Compensation Range:**

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $159,000 - $185,000. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for a new hire in this position. The base pay actually offered to the successful candidate will take into account internal equity, work location, and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Please note that base pay is only one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This range allows for the successful candidate to have an opportunity to progress within the position and develop at our company. This base pay range does not take into account bonuses, equity, or other benefits which may be applicable and are dependent on the level and position offered.

**What do we offer?**

We provide competitive and comprehensive benefits to our employees. Below are some highlights of our benefits:

* Life and Disability Insurance

**Recruitment Scam Alert**

We've become aware that scammers are impersonating members of our recruitment team by using fake email addresses and fraudulent job opportunities.

Please remember:

We will never ask you to pay for an interview, job offer, equipment, training, or any part of our recruitment process. Always verify that recruitment emails come from our official company email domain (revvity.com). Revvity will never conduct interviews via text message, messaging apps, or social media direct messages. If you're ever unsure whether a recruitment message is genuine, please contact us through our official careers website before responding.
 
 
Your safety is important to us.
 
If you believe you've been targeted by recruitment fraud in the United States, you can report it to the Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) at https://www.ic3.gov/ or the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) at https://reportfraud.ftc.gov .
